description: This Java class defines an Android activity that displays a grid of app icons loaded dynamically from installed applications. It includes methods to load app info, create views for the grid, and manage the adapter for presenting app icons within a GridView.

classes.name: LayoutAnimation1
classes.description: Main activity class that loads app icons and sets up the grid view.

classes.name: LayoutAnimation1.AppsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for populating the grid with app icons.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads apps, and sets up the grid view with an adapter.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Queries the package manager for launchable activities and stores the list.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates and returns an ImageView for each app icon in the grid.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items to display (up to 32).

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the app info object at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as item ID.
